limitations: Known author-created protocol cases from the prior frozen transfer experiment, not independently held-out evidence.
Recovery uses a pretrained model and deterministic execution; this does not establish general intelligence or model independence.
Each retry uses a new task ID and fresh baseline/candidate executions; prior failed verification and rejected plan remain trace history.
Reported tokens and latency are current replay costs, excluding previously reported learning and development costs. No direct-model cost advantage is claimed.
One bounded replacement attempt only. Another failed check, duplicate edit, exhausted budget or unavailable model stops without success.
Correctness is limited to supplied checks. Hostile-code attestation, diagnosis causality and unseen behavior remain unproven.
Persisting two incompatible edits may make later exact recall ambiguous; normal model fallback remains necessary.
Raw run artifacts remain in ignored runs/repair-transfer folders; original unsuccessful experiments remain in results.json.

cli.scope: Known-case recovery development replay; not a held-out comparison.

validation.browser: Verified completed report, one model request, 1861 tokens, failed then successful execution evidence, and the five-units replacement diff.
